# Repo-owned fmt snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [fmtlib/fmt](https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt) at commit `e3ddede6c4ee818825c4e5a6dfa1d384860c27d9`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 132 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original permissive `LICENSE`, including its optional binary-form notice exception, is retained in full. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
